htmlPageOnboarding.title: Design this page with your AI assistant
htmlPageOnboarding.lead: A page is written from outside Jadawel. Connect an assistant to this workspace's MCP server, tell it which page to write, and describe what you want to see.

htmlPageOnboarding.sanadHint: Sanad, Jadawel's assistant, can write this page for you with nothing to set up. Describe what you want to see and it builds the page from this table's rows.

htmlPageOnboarding.askTitle: Ask for the page you want
htmlPageOnboarding.askHint: Paste this into your assistant and replace the last line with your own description.
htmlPageOnboarding.promptTemplate:
Using the Jadawel MCP server, design page {viewId}.

First call get_page_view with view_id {viewId} to read the runtime contract, the fields and a sample of the rows. Then write the page with update_page_view.

The visual design is entirely yours — any layout, any style. What I want on the page:
[describe it here]
htmlPageOnboarding.freedomNote: The look is entirely up to the assistant. The only hard rule is the sandbox: the page cannot reach the network, so it must be self-contained. Turn on external resources in the settings menu if you want it to use a CDN library.
